answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using remote attestation anchored in secure enclaves potted in opaque onyx resin. Agents authenticate by signing challenge nonces with factory-fused keys; an attacker cannot forge credentials without incurring the verifiable capital cost of provisioning discrete physical chips per identity. However, microcode vulnerabilities or leaked vendor keys can ripple through the network, triggering mass revocations that disrupt valid agents.
